task.description: WF-04, step 1 — GUI-DESIGN-ANALYST writes docs/design/V1-public-look.md: the description of the public look of Sai's landing from the approved v3 sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/ (README.md, index.html, styles.css, app.js, office.js, data.js and every image in shots/), for the pages of PLAN M1.4 (landing with the stage scene, how it works, examples, the demo survey and its result, 404) in Sai's content: the four desks «Принято», «Готовим документацию», «Готовим спецификацию», «Готово к просмотру», the «Вы» figure, the caption «Картинка показывает этапы работы, а не движения людей.», the test-mode line, the AI disclosure, the language switch (ru/en; kk hidden on production) and the theme switch «Авто / Светлая / Тёмная». It gives, measured from the sample where it exists: the layout of each page at 1470×784, 390×844 and 320×568; colour tokens for light and dark with computed contrast ratios (text at least 4.5:1, accents and control borders at least 3:1; ARCH §11.7 refuses accents below 3:1); typography; spacing; every component with its states (cards, buttons, one-tap answers, the result card, panels, banner, switches, focus rings); the stage scene drawing (integer pixel scale, desks, monitors, plates, figures, bubbles; fillRect/fillText only, colours read from the CSS tokens); motion and prefers-reduced-motion; the not-carried-over list of ARCH §11.7 item by item with where the sample has it; the CSP rule (no inline style= or script, no innerHTML: textContent only). Every value says whether it is measured from the sample (file and line or shot) or proposed, never guessed silently. No code of app/. Run M1SITE-20261119-01 is the WF-01 run of R1.2 (REQ-111) and R1.3 (REQ-112) with WF-04 step 1 for the look (PLAN §4.1, PUBLIC LOOK lane; PLAN M1 and M1.4; ARCH §2, §2.1, §2.2, §11.4, §11.6, §11.7, §14, §17, §18, §19; decisions 0065, 0074 item 6, 0080, 0083, 0084, 0097, 0099, 0116, 0118, 0122). REQ-111 and REQ-112 are written at the same time by REQ-ANALYST in step 01 (gate 02). Owner gates in force: G8 not asked (default «б»: the order-related landing texts are built and checked locally only, no prices, sales or ads, noindex, the test-mode banner); G9 not asked (kk hidden on production); G21 (a look release reaches production only after the owner's «похоже» on the page itself); decision 0083 item 7 (public pages never show agent events); nothing a visitor types or taps is stored («Без ... данных»). The owner's words for this run, verbatim: 2026-11-17 (decisions/0115) «Продолжи работу, так чтобы я получил готовый продукт» and «Публичный сайт V1 (Recommended)»; 2026-11-17 (PROGRESS.md, gate row «M1.1 narrowing») «Сначала каркас (Recommended)»; 2026-10-28 (G18) «Да, новые по-английски (Рекомендую)»; 2026-11-18 – 19 (docs/owner-requests/2026-10-27-public-launch-plan.md, the appended section) «пуш, брат. Я хочу чтобы ты меня понял в корне и дал мне результат. Исходя нашей переписки и в целом» and «Да, сайт по ссылке (Recommended)» with its option text. issues.text: REQ-111 and REQ-112 did not exist when this description was begun; it was aligned with both blocks after step 01 closed (11:21:48Z), as written before their gate 02. If the gate changes a block (storage, the intake format, the step table, what may move), a rework step of this description follows it.

Team cards on the landing: the sample's row of four cards has 97.3 px of text at 1470 [M run]; REQ-112's titles «Руководитель проекта», «Проверяющий» and «Разработчик» measure 119.4 (the first word), 123.7 and 109.1 px at 16/900. Default: a 2×2 grid of row cards (154.6 px of text, §7.7). Else: shorter titles or a smaller font. ORCH decides in decision 0123.

Storage: the task says «nothing a visitor types or taps is stored»; REQ-111 keeps two one-word preferences in localStorage, sai-lang and sai-theme (its question О2, ARCH §17). The description follows REQ-111; if ORCH answers О2 «nothing at all», §2, §3 S65, §11 and §12 change to the address-only form.

The theme button's accessible name «<name>: <position>» (REQ-111 criterion 4): the sample's name «Свет» / «Жарық» / «Light» (data.js:10, 51, 92) reads «Light: Light» in English. Default «Тема» / «Тақырып» / «Theme»; the wording is REQ-111's texts module.

The step table of §9.13 is this description's proposal (REQ-112 says the look description names it): questions 1–5 asked at desks 1, 2, 3, 3, 4 (the sample's st and the v3 demo tenants' desk), «Вы» at the door until the first answer, then at the desk that asks the next question, desk 4 for the result; how.html step n → desk n; «Назад» and the result chips walk back. ORCH confirms or changes it in decision 0123.

REQ-112 criterion 4 lets draw.js set only fillStyle, font, textAlign and textBaseline (no globalAlpha). The sample's translucency (desk shadows .22, window beams .16, the light layer, the night glow; office.js:256, 266, 290, 366-381) is described with rgba fill styles from a closed list (§9.4, §9.11), and each desk's light bands are clipped to its own column so the list stays finite. If the gate prefers to allow globalAlpha, the criterion changes, not the look.
REQ-112 puts the scene on the landing, how and the demo only; the sample's not-found view (app.js:328) had the scene. Default: 404.html and examples.html without the scene and without the caption.

Vertical budget: the two required lines (the test-mode strip, 34/46/46–63 px, and the caption, 28/24/40 px) put the demo's «<enough…>» button about 10 px below the fold at 1470×784, 11–22 px of «Не знаю» under the fixed phone bar at 390×844, and the landing's big button 66–83 px below the fold at 320×568 (§8.1, §8.4; the sample showed all of them). Default: accepted as measured; the alternatives (a shorter strip text, a lower stage) change a measured value of the sample.

No pixel icons on the answer cards: REQ-111's intake is format /2 (no object per option), chosen because /3 needs four named staff. The cards take the sample's «Не знаю» card shape. If the owner wants the sample's icons on the cards, the intake or the page needs an object per option (a choice for ORCH and REQ-111).

Order of the theme labels: decisions/0084 §3 item 15 writes «Светлая / Тёмная / Авто», while PLAN M1, ARCH §17, REQ-087, REQ-111 and the task write «Авто / Светлая / Тёмная». Measured: the sample's button cycles auto → day → night → auto (app.js:383) and starts at auto (app.js:25), so both lists name the same cycle from different starts; the description uses «Авто» → «Светлая» → «Тёмная» → «Авто». No change of a record is needed.
